seamspaceGroup.subtitle: Student Management & Communication Platform for Teachers
seamspaceGroup.description: A management platform designed for teachers to review student diaries, monitor emotional trends, communicate with students, manage newsletters and reports, and better understand student engagement and well-being.

contributions.contribution1: Developed and maintained Diary, Mailbox, Reports, Notifications, and Admin Dashboard modules.
contributions.contribution2: Built reusable and responsive UI components based on Figma designs.
contributions.contribution3: Implemented multilingual support (i18n) across the platform.
contributions.contribution4: Improved application performance through component optimization and lazy loading.
contributions.contribution5: Collaborated with backend developers and UI/UX designers throughout the development lifecycle.

contributions.contribution1: Developed student diary features using Flutter and Dart.

contributions.contribution5: Implemented multilingual support for multiple languages.
contributions.contribution6: Optimized application lifecycle handling and application performance.
